ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity (white/tan) to low-intensity (black) pixels, approximately 1:10, with high-intensity areas concentrated on the distal tips and scattered linear marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a solid black field. Distinct high-contrast tan/white clusters are mapped to the extreme lateral distal tips. Narrow, high-contrast white linear segments are scattered irregularly across both the medial and lateral regions of the fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 65-75 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary with irregular serrations; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys increases toward the lateral tips, ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to sharp distal tips; leading edge exhibits a convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast tan/white pixels (barnacle encrustations) localized on the extreme left and right distal tips of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High detection of unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) traversing the black field, with higher concentrations in the right-medial region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both lobes; significant linear rake-mark scarring across the ventral surface.
